set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols pim interface [parameter1].explanation: This command enables Protocol Independent Multicast (PIM) on a specified network interface (`[parameter1]`) for multicast routing in Junos OS.

mode [parameter2].explanation: Enable a thin PIM mode (an independent multicast protocol) on all interfaces.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.explanation: PIM mode, sparse means thin mode.

unit [parameter2] family inet address [p.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set protocols igmp interface [parameter1.explanation: This command enables IGMP (Internet Group Management Protocol) on a specified network interface (`[parameter1]`) for multicast group management.

version [parameter2].explanation: Configure IGMP version 3 on the specified interface.

set protocols ospf area [parameter1].explanation: This command configures an OSPF area in Junos OS, where `[parameter1]` specifies the area ID, enabling OSPF routing within the defined area.

interface [parameter2].explanation: Enables the interface in the assigned OSPF area.
